measurement_method: Environment Agency Defra Data Services Platform official dataset metadata
spatial_binding_method: Official published geographic extent bounds converted directly to EPSG:4326 coverage Polygon; source-area only

field_evidence.pulse_semantics: last or only laser pulse returned to sensor; includes buildings, vegetation and terrain surface
field_evidence.measurement_date_semantics: dataset period end; not asserted as capture date for every raster cell

limitations: This package is source-area coverage evidence only, not repository canonical parcel acceptance.
The published geographic extent is a dataset bounding box, not an assertion that every point inside is populated.
No building-footprint/canonical-parcel spatial join is established.
No official DEM/LIDAR min/max/mean/max-min statistics were computed for a building-containing canonical parcel.
